prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a Fanggu heritage line plate. Image 1 is the actual monument PHOTO and controls geometry. Image 2 is ONLY the project black fine-contour STYLE sample; never transfer its Buddha subject. Draw the named Japanese building accurately as a complete, isolated elevation at nearly frontal view. Fine sparse black ink contours with a few structural lines; no broad dark fills, hatching, pencil grain or opaque silhouettes. Pure flat opaque WHITE #FFFFFF canvas, including every blank region inside and outside the subject. Center with generous margins. No shadow, gradient, texture, glow, checkerboard, color, text, labels, signage, people, foliage, surrounding buildings, watermark or frame. Subject: Daitoku-ji MAIN temple Hojo, the ACTUAL 1635-36 long abbot quarters in the Kyoto Prefecture photo, not Ryogen-in or Daisen-in. Preserve long one-story facade, gray tiled hip-and-gable roof, veranda, repetitive dark wooden shutters and pale upper walls; omit courtyard and other buildings.
